channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: US waives oil sanctions, to release $12bn in frozen funds
item.description: US says the decisions follow Iran's commitment to allow international nuclear inspections.

item.title: Video shows deadly shooting in Montreal, Canada
item.description: A police officer, a civilian and the suspected gunman were killed after a shooting in Montreal.

item.title: Czech public media staff strike, citing government threat to independence
item.description: Plan to put funding under direct control has sparked widespread opposition, with critics fearing political interference.

item.title: 15 killed after a fire ignited in a coaching centre in Lucknow, India
item.description: 15 killed after a fire ignited in a coaching centre in Lucknow, India.

item.title: Qatar PM on preventing US-Iran talks from escalation
item.description: Qatar's PM said that safeguards have been put in place to prevent US-Iran negotiations from regional escalation.

item.title: US eases oil sanctions as Iran denies Vance claim on nuclear inspectors
item.description: Iran's foreign ministry says it made "no new commitments" on nuclear inspections after talks in Switzerland.

item.title: At least 13 killed and dozens injured after Qatar gas explosion
item.description: The city's main liquified natural gas (LNG) processing site suffered a "technical accident" in the Ras Laffan industrial zone.

item.title: Myanmar army killed over 700 civilians in six months, UN says
item.description: The new UN report says the 702 civilian deaths over six months last year included 153 children.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill six people in Gaza including Al Jazeera cameraman, officials say
item.description: The Israeli military accused Ahmed Wishah of being a "Hamas sniper operative", without providing evidence.

item.title: Thousands killed in US-Israeli war on Iran - but experts say true total may never be known
item.description: Experts say internet, media and government restrictions have all hampered casualty reporting across the region.
